CHK-009 ("Prove the gate verdict is order-independent after the fix") was added in PLAN phase: INIT reviewer raised this twice (DRAFT-106 then INIT-002) and it was deferred to PLAN on the explicit condition that it become a real checklist item rather than an optional addition; acceptance section 10.3 row O2 was otherwise covered by no item.

9 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Commit a repro-first RED artifact proving both crash classes still live on current main + Establish the pre-fix invariance baseline from main's existing five-scenario harness are performed simultaneously?)

story hit 2 high-risk signal(s): Data Migration/Destructive, State Machine/Gate. Recommend stricter review standards (>= 3 preMortem scenarios, explicit rollback path). If this story only mentions rather than modifies that area (false positive), run lattice story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-2aa7","category":"<category>","reason":"..."}' to fully roll back the auto-elevation (after all auto-elevated riskSignals are dismissed, priority auto-reverts and high-risk gates are lifted).

missing_original_intent_snapshot: Intent MVP requires original_intent_snapshot_set with sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_intent_collision: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_red_evidence: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

scope_ambiguity: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-2aa7 --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
